Exact rational checks and matrix corroboration were replayed from the attached checker; finite tests do not replace the analytical proof.

value.rationale: The degeneration of annular Hardy multipliers has a natural sharp spectral scaling. The theorem identifies its complete nontrivial radial-angular spectral law, computes all Schatten-power asymptotics, singles out a true \(p=1/2\) degeneration threshold, and relates the critical limit to half the parametrized length of the boundary image curve. It is not a table lookup or mere renaming: mixed Laurent frequencies yield an interference angular factor missing for a coordinate shift. This provides a geometric spectral invariant and a benchmark for analytic multipliers on degenerating multiply connected domains.
